numbering.note: The human/mouse offset is NOT constant; it varies from 0 to +26 across the chain. Always convert via piezo1.core.sequence.load_numbering_map().

domains.name: THU1 (TM1-TM4)
domains.description: Transmembrane helical unit 1 of the mechanosensory blade, comprising TM1-TM4. Distal blade — not resolved in any experimental structure; modelled from AlphaFold.
domains.source: UniProt Q92508 transmembrane features, grouped in fours from the N-terminus

domains.source: UniProt Q92508 transmembrane features, grouped in fours from the N-terminus

domains.name: THU3 (TM9-TM12)
domains.description: Transmembrane helical unit 3 of the mechanosensory blade, comprising TM9-TM12. Distal blade — not resolved in any experimental structure; modelled from AlphaFold.
domains.source: UniProt Q92508 transmembrane features, grouped in fours from the N-terminus

domains.name: THU4 (TM13-TM16)
domains.description: Transmembrane helical unit 4 of the mechanosensory blade, comprising TM13-TM16. Proximal blade — resolved in cryo-EM.
domains.source: UniProt Q92508 transmembrane features, grouped in fours from the N-terminus

domains.name: THU5 (TM17-TM20)
domains.description: Transmembrane helical unit 5 of the mechanosensory blade, comprising TM17-TM20. Proximal blade — resolved in cryo-EM.
domains.source: UniProt Q92508 transmembrane features, grouped in fours from the N-terminus

domains.name: THU6 (TM21-TM24)
domains.description: Transmembrane helical unit 6 of the mechanosensory blade, comprising TM21-TM24. Proximal blade — resolved in cryo-EM.
domains.source: UniProt Q92508 transmembrane features, grouped in fours from the N-terminus

domains.name: THU7 (TM25-TM28)
domains.description: Transmembrane helical unit 7 of the mechanosensory blade, comprising TM25-TM28. Proximal blade — resolved in cryo-EM.
domains.source: UniProt Q92508 transmembrane features, grouped in fours from the N-terminus

domains.name: Beam
domains.description: Long intracellular helix running from beneath the distal blade to the pore module. The lever arm of the lever-like transduction mechanism: blade motion is transmitted along the beam to the anchor and thence to the inner helix.
domains.source: Zhao et al. Nature 2018 (PMID 30089899); Wang et al. Nat Commun 2018 (PMID 29610524)

domains.name: Clasp
domains.description: Intracellular region following the beam that packs against the blade; proposed to stabilise blade-beam coupling. Boundaries are approximate and partly unresolved in cryo-EM.

domains.name: THU8 (TM29-TM32)
domains.description: Transmembrane helical unit 8 of the mechanosensory blade, comprising TM29-TM32. Proximal blade — resolved in cryo-EM.
domains.source: UniProt Q92508 transmembrane features, grouped in fours from the N-terminus

domains.name: THU9 (TM33-TM36)
domains.description: Transmembrane helical unit 9 of the mechanosensory blade, comprising TM33-TM36. Proximal blade — resolved in cryo-EM.
domains.source: UniProt Q92508 transmembrane features, grouped in fours from the N-terminus

domains.name: Anchor domain
domains.description: Amphipathic intracellular domain wedged between the blade and the pore module. Transmits beam motion to the outer helix and hosts a cholesterol-interaction site (human P2113).
domains.source: UniProt Q92508 topology; Buyan et al. Biophys J 2020 (PMID 32949489)
domains.rule: cytoplasmic topological domain between TM36 and TM37

domains.name: Latch
domains.description: Short intracellular segment linking the anchor to the outer helix; implicated in coupling and in inactivation. Approximate.

domains.name: Outer helix (OH)
domains.description: Penultimate transmembrane helix; forms the outer wall of the pore module.

domains.name: Cap / C-terminal extracellular domain (CED)
domains.description: Trimeric extracellular cap sitting above the pore, 234 residues per protomer. Contains the C2411-C2415 disulfide and carries the Er blood-group antigens. Rotates during gating and controls ion permeation through lateral portals.
domains.source: UniProt Q92508 topology; Karamatic Crew et al. Blood 2023
domains.rule: extracellular topological domain between TM37 and TM38

domains.name: Inner helix (IH, pore-lining)
domains.description: Final transmembrane helix. Three copies line the ion-conduction pathway and form the transmembrane gate.

domains.name: C-terminal domain (CTD)
domains.description: Intracellular domain beneath the pore forming the cytoplasmic vestibule and the constriction that sets ion selectivity. Hosts the acidic residues controlling divalent permeation and most gain-of-function xerocytosis variants.
domains.source: UniProt Q92508 topology; Coste et al. Nature 2015 (PMID 26649819)
